name: bent
title: Bent
description: Every hinge about half way: elbows flexed to about 90°, knees to about 80°, wrists bent about 35° (the left one way, the right the other), the hips raised 20°, the ankles bent back so the soles stay level. Open enough to see the crook of each joint, where its skin folds; the check for joint creases.
